Bureau d'Etudes de Recherches et Consulting International, Kinshasa. The only standing national polling capacity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, working with the Congo Research Group and Ipsos on nationwide surveys drawn from a 2016 face to face frame of 7500 households across 469 sites. Founding year could not be established. Whether its microdata reaches researchers is not established, so it is coded commercial_only rather than credited with disclosure it may not offer

Institut de Formation et de Recherche Demographiques, created by the United Nations and Cameroon in 1971 and open from November 1972. An intergovernmental institute of 22 francophone African and Indian Ocean states that has trained over 1200 African demographers. Named in the 2025 DHS terminations

Zomba research organisation incorporated in the United States in 2004 and in Malawi in 2008, running fieldwork for the World Bank the University of Pennsylvania and Oxford among others. Built around training Malawian researchers rather than importing them for each study

Runs a rural health and demographic surveillance system of about 125000 people from 1996 and an urban one of about 45000 from 2007. Began as a Swiss field research station in 1956 and became an independent Tanzanian nonprofit in 1996, which is the year recorded here

Builds credit profiles from mobile network and mobile money behaviour for people with no credit file, operating with operators and banks in Ghana Kenya Tanzania Zambia Uganda Cote d'Ivoire South Africa and Cameroon. The register's clearest case of telecom signalling turned into a person level financial record

Addis Ababa firm scoring micro and small enterprises that have no collateral and no credit history, with Mastercard Foundation backing aimed at some 477800 of them. Ethiopia's first entry in this segment and the only one in the register

Lets two organisations match and analyse their customer files against each other without either handing over the underlying records, using tokenised keys. TransUnion took a minority stake. An African firm selling a way to combine consumer data without pooling it, which is the opposite of the brokerage model

Abuja newsroom founded in March 2020 building conflict and displacement datasets out of open source investigation and geographic information systems alongside its reporting, including a standing incident tracker. Won a Sigma Award for data journalism in 2024

Dakar peace research centre with offices in Niamey and Bamako, grown out of an observatory of radicalism that ran until 2016. Collects attitudinal data on radicalisation in the Sahel where security conditions keep most agencies out

Collective of Sudanese journalists founded in 2013 in the Nuba Mountains under pseudonyms, working openly from Khartoum after 2019. Its office was attacked when the war began in 2023 and equipment hard drives and thousands of hours of footage were lost, which is what a register of collectors should record about collection under war
Produces the Sudan Conflict Monitor with Ayin and the Sudan Human Rights Hub, tracking the war and the finances behind it. Founding year could not be established and is left NA
